snippet.title: SUPERBUG - Demo Trailer (V1.0)
snippet.description:
Play SUPERBUG on itch.io now! https://plumicorn.itch.io/superbug
Join the discord server! https://discord.gg/4qz2fBs9uA

Put the pandemics of this world to shame in this colorful arcade shooter! Wreak havoc and sow chaos with blinding momentum. Compete for high scores and combos!
